title: Parallel Agents - Zed
snapshot_note: Structured fact packet distilled from Zed's public Parallel Agents documentation.

facts.statement: Parallel Agents lets users run multiple agent threads at once, each with its own agent, context window, and conversation history.
From version 0.233.0 onward, the Agent Panel and Threads Sidebar are on the left by default, with the Project Panel and Git Panel on the right.
The Threads Sidebar groups threads by project and shows thread title, status indicator, and active agent.
The Threads Sidebar can hold multiple projects at once, each with its own thread list and conversation history.
A single project can contain multiple folders so agents can read and write across those folders in one thread.
If two threads might edit the same files, users can start one in a new Git worktree to give it an isolated checkout.
